content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the klaipėda district court the court decided to dissolve a marriage between the applicant and the defendant the applicant was awarded a husqvarna vehicle a volkswagen multivan and a ½ share of a flat while the defendant was awarded the other ½ part of the apartment the debt from the marriage remains a joint obligation for both parties the defendant was ordered to pay compensation of eur 750 to the applicant for their greater share of the property acquired during the marriage the court discussed various articles of the civil code related to matrimonial property the applicant sought the dissolution of the marriage establishment of residence for their minor children payment of damages for the children division of property and payment of compensation the court considered the evidence and arguments presented by both parties to make a decision on each matter the court also annulled interim measures imposed previously
